slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Receiving a buyout offer is a significant moment, and evaluating it properly, including understanding the business's true value and any finance implications, takes time. Getting proper advice before responding protects your position.

caption:
A buyout offer is flattering and can be a genuine opportunity, but it's worth resisting any pressure to respond quickly, proper valuation and advice take time, and that time is almost always available.

Understanding how any existing finance arrangements factor into the deal is one practical piece of that evaluation worth getting right early.
